plan.name: Produce Go test events through a reusable local transport
plan.summary: Deliver #538 in one pull request: add an optional host-owned process transport and its local implementation, together with a production Go producer that obtains ordered starts, logs, pauses, resumes and terminal results directly from Go testing lifecycle hooks on a channel independent of both diagnostic streams. Reuse production Select, Discover, private verbatim staging and invocation binding, preserving the complete captured command grammar, Go semantics, offline dependency boundary, owning part and import path, and every existing test without changing discovery-only fixtures. All work inherits the caller's remaining allowance, and the disposable part environment retains helpers and partial-start handles until bounded uncanceled Close; the producer and transport must stop and reap every descendant in each owned process group before a synchronous Run or Wait returns, before startup returns an error, and before Close returns, including compilers and silent children on normal exit, failure or cancellation, while bounding drains and preserving diagnostics, infrastructure errors and unfinished work without inventing completion. Eight default acceptance tests use actual local Go processes and isolated caches to cover the combined transport and producer requirements; update SPEC.md, docs/factory.md and the README adapter-status sentence to describe this implemented boundary while keeping RepositoryAcceptanceEvidence conversion, RunAcceptance integration, compiler-failure qualification, prepared-Docker transport and broader shared integration pending, keeping configured planning admission, default or candidate adapter registration, production pytest/Vitest/Jest and external plumbing disabled, and preserving legacy execution, hashes and locks. Changed SPEC bullets cite recorded foundations including D-0321, README stays within 400 lines with detail in docs/factory.md, and the merger confirms D-0321 and records the new producer/transport decision before dependent work proceeds, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/; unavailable Docker/network checks are merger work, while affected real Python/TLAPS suites remain required in CI.

tests.name: TestGoProducerChangesOnlyProductionOutcome
tests.says: The same verbatim acceptance source really fails against the base and passes after changing only production, preserving fresh invocation binding, discovered import path, local imports, private staging and isolated offline caches.

tests.name: TestGoProducerSelectsExactRuntimeCases
tests.says: Real nested and parallel lifecycle events retain exact runtime parents and children; literal punctuation and shell-looking names, parameter neighbors, external tests, tags, packages, modules and owning parts cannot substitute for the requested case.

tests.name: TestGoProducerRefusesBeforeRuntime
tests.says: Unsupported captured commands fail before preparation; actual loading, exact-source, inclusion, declaration, module, dependency and compilation failures prevent producer launch without changing existing selection or discovery policy.

tests.name: TestGoProducerPreservesCapturedFlags
tests.says: Actual executions and literal argument observations preserve both spellings and all supported flag values, including explicit false, timeout zero, count one, shuffle, tags, readonly/vendor, race and trimpath, with ordinary Go controls for semantics and toolchain errors. Each run returns only after its whole process group, including compiler descendants, has stopped and been reaped, so shared-phase temporary-directory cleanup cannot race a surviving writer.

tests.name: TestGoProducerReportsAuthenticLifecycle
tests.says: Actual testing hooks report pass, assertion failure, skip and panic explanations while preserving initialization, TestMain, cleanup, nested and parallel failure propagation, and distinguishing zero execution or missing children from started but unfinished abrupt exits.

tests.name: TestGoProducerIgnoresDiagnosticImpostors
tests.says: Spoofed lifecycle text, JSON, framing and complete binding-looking records in both stdout and stderr during initialization, TestMain and tests remain inspectable diagnostics and cannot change independent framework events or host binding.

tests.name: TestLocalGoTransportOwnsChannelsAndResources
tests.says: Production transport stages confined private regular files and routes independent opaque event/stdout/stderr bytes from real subprocesses with literal arguments and the owning working directory, retaining exit and launch errors, reporting the empty GOENV path for disabled Go configuration, and stopping and reaping the whole process group before Run or Wait returns, including silent child and grandchild writers, with bounded drains and idempotent release.

tests.name: TestGoProducerBoundsCancellationAndPartialStartup
tests.says: Validation, reads, preparation, loading, compilation, helper work and real runtime interruption inherit the same remaining deadline; handles returned with errors remain owned through bounded uncanceled cleanup, and infrastructure or cleanup errors and incomplete lifecycle survive without synthesized terminal results. Canceled loading, compilation and runtime, and failed startup, leave no running or unreaped descendants when they return; the same is required of Close.
